description: CSV join (inner/left/right/full/anti) — Join two CSV files on a key column like a SQL join and get the merged table back as JSON rows plus a ready-to-save CSV. how=inner (default), left, right, full, or anti (rows of a with no match in b). on=column when both files share the name, or on=leftColumn:rightColumn when they differ; omitted, it picks a shared id-like column. Keys are trimmed and numbers match numerically (007 = 7); ignoreCase=true for case-insensitive keys. Clashing column names from b get a _b suffix. Returns match stats (match rate, unmatched keys on each side with samples, duplicate keys in b) so you can see data-quality problems. limit= output rows (default 5,000, max 20,000); format=csv returns only the CSV. Offline, nothing stored. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_join
